component.name: Cactus
component.summary: Native Linux-first browser — quiet by default

description.p: Cactus is a Wayland-first Linux browser built in Rust on GTK4, libadwaita, and WebKitGTK. It prioritizes desktop integration, privacy-by-default (tracker blocking, HTTPS-First, no telemetry), and a lighter footprint than Chromium shells.
Privacy dashboard with live session stats, new-tab privacy summary, project landing page, and Ctrl+Shift+P shortcut.
Initial usable daily-driver release: tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, private windows, and ad/tracker blocking.
